create_client_hf_inference: create an OpenAI client configured to use the Hugging Face router as the base URL
create_chat_stream: create a streaming chat completion request to an LLM model via Hugging Face inference
iterate_stream_chunks: iterate over streaming chat completion chunks and print each delta content
configure_model_inference: configure a chat completion call with a specific Hugging Face model and user messages
run_streaming_llm_response: run a streaming LLM inference call and consume the response chunk by chunk
